testcase.name: Authentication and access control › TC-Auth-01: a visitor registers as Student or Contributor within 3 s; a reused email is refused
Authentication and access control › TC-Auth-05: "abc12" and "abcdefgh" are rejected with "Password too weak"; "abcdef12" is accepted
Authentication and access control › TC-Auth-05: the server also rejects a weak password sent directly to the API
Authentication and access control › TC-Auth-02: correct credentials open the home page for the role; wrong ones show the error and create no session
Authentication and access control › TC-Auth-03: each role sees only its permitted features, and forbidden requests get 403 "Access denied"
Authentication and access control › TC-Auth-04: logout ends the session; protected pages show the login page and the old token is refused
Material sharing › TC-Mat-01: a contributor uploads a 20 MB PDF, it is confirmed within 10 s and appears in search
Material sharing › TC-Sec-04: a 21 MB PDF and an executable renamed to .pdf are rejected with "Invalid file"

Material sharing › TC-Mat-03: a download matches the stored file size and adds exactly 1 to the count each time

testcase.name: Question bank › TC-QB-01: a 500-character question with 4 options and 1 correct answer is saved; 3 options or 2 correct are rejected
Question bank › TC-QB-02: own questions can be edited and deleted; another contributor gets "Access denied"; a question in a published quiz is "in use"
Question bank › TC-QB-03: a question needs a topic and difficulty, and filtering by Algebra and Easy returns only matching questions
Quizzes › TC-Quiz-01: quizzes with 5-50 questions and 5-180 minutes are accepted; 4/51 questions and 4/181 minutes are rejected
Quizzes › TC-Quiz-04: a student sees every published quiz with its title, number of questions and time limit
Quizzes › TC-Quiz-02: the countdown stays within 1 s of server time and answers are submitted automatically at 00:00
Quizzes › TC-Quiz-03: 7 correct, 2 wrong and 1 unanswered show 7/10, 70% and every correct answer within 3 s
Quizzes › TC-Quiz-05: a contributor deletes their own quiz, students no longer see it, and another contributor gets "Access denied"
Performance reports and moderation › TC-Rep-01: a student sees an overall average, topic scores and attempts that match a manual calculation
Performance reports and moderation › TC-Rep-02: a contributor sees attempts, average, highest, lowest and the 3 hardest questions for own quizzes only
Performance reports and moderation › TC-Adm-01: an admin removes a material and a quiz; students no longer find either

Security validation (Test Plan 5.1) › TC-Sec-02: a Student token on Contributor-only and Admin-only requests gets 403 "Access denied"
Security validation (Test Plan 5.1) › TC-Sec-03: missing, altered, 31-minute-old and revoked tokens all get 401
Security validation (Test Plan 5.1) › TC-Sec-06: login success and failure, upload and deletion each write one audit entry with user, action and time
